title: GMS Week 41 - Owners Hold All The Cards

section_path_text: GMS Week 41 - Owners Hold All The Cards
summary:
Main
Last week, Chattogram reclaimed first place on the conventional recycling board. This week, its leading bid has been leftlooking for something to buy. Across the sub-continent, the familiar imbalance persists: end buyers are available, prices remain broadly intact, and the ships needed to turn both into transactions are still earning money elsewhere.
